prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: The last attached image shows this exact place in the present day, ruined. Repaint the SAME place with EXACTLY the same layout, camera, building positions, doors, stairs, exits and walkable areas as that last image (it is the floor plan reference, keep every position), but SEVEN YEARS EARLIER, when everything was intact and in use. "Digitech-Areal, seven years ago": the gleaming headquarters plaza of a wealthy tech corporation at night: clean polished pale stone tiles with neat inlaid lines, no cracks, no weeds, trimmed hedges in white planters. TOP: the office tower facade fully intact, all glass panes whole, cool white and blue light in the windows, chrome trim (where the collapsed facade is in the reference: an intact glass lobby front with a revolving door). The archive door and the cellar stairwell door are closed steel security doors with small card readers and blue lamps. The emergency terminal is a clean new console glowing calm blue. TOP RIGHT: the delivery gate with a working barrier and camera, a guard booth lit. RIGHT SIDE, where the colossus kneels in the reference: a clean empty helipad-like circle marking on the floor with two small sleek white security drones parked on charging pads (no giant robot). CENTER LEFT: the abstract ring sculpture intact on a clean plinth with a small fountain. BOTTOM LEFT: the gatehouse new and lit. BOTTOM RIGHT, where the scavenger camp is: a neat row of parked white service carts and stacked branded crates (no letters). BOTTOM CENTER: a closed square steel maintenance hatch. The construction fence on the left edge is instead a tall smart metal security fence with a narrow service gate. Light and material: Oberstadt - cold clean white light, chrome, glass, blue security lamps, a red alarm light here and there; night, light rain.
